method.before: Selectively normalized expression division with Decimal256 ROUND preparation and quotient reuse.
method.after: Previously tested fused Decimal division; unchanged implementation.
method.shared: Identical patched functions, physical-plan, optimizer, physical-optimizer, Sail lateral alias source, lockfile and benchmark. Only sail-plan scalar/math.rs changes between builds.
method.scope: Execution only, preloaded Arrow arrays, 1048576 rows, batch size 8192, one partition, CPU 2. No planning, Delta I/O or concurrent-query timings.
method.counter_scope: Existing perf FIFO control enables after warmups and disables after measured executions. Counts include handshake and loop bookkeeping; no setup/planning or warmups.
method.retention: Retain all samples. Compare all 36 timed samples per case/variant using median and mean. Selected-case counter measurements remain separate.
method.limits: One machine with unfixed CPU frequency and possible SMT/background interference. Unchanged DOUBLE plans and effectively equal instruction counts still have timing variation. This comparison does not establish a global zero-regression guarantee or measure subquery planning, required sorting/compensation, Delta I/O or concurrent queries.

build_notes: After switching math.rs, its mtime was refreshed to force recompilation. Both final builds use the same paths, locked dependency versions and flags. Physical-plan checks verify the intended arithmetic implementation in every benchmark case.
capture_scope: The Delta wrapper records the host vendor hash. These candidates are identified by the recorded source, lockfile and saved binary hashes, with the same four local DataFusion dependency overrides.

error_review.scope: ANSI result-overflow errors. The expression reports the final cast/precision check; fused division reports its own result-precision check. Full messages remain in direct_comparison. Other tested error messages are unchanged.
